plugin.name: Hypr Overview
plugin.description: Visual Hyprland overview with live window previews

grid.title: Workspace Grid

animationProfile.label: Animation profile
animationProfile.description: How quickly workspace cards and windows animate

grid.scale-warning: Current settings exceed screen size. Overview is being scaled down to fit.

hide-empty-rows.label: Hide empty rows
hide-empty-rows.description: Automatically hide workspace rows with no windows

show-scratchpad.label: Show scratchpad windows
show-scratchpad.description: Include special/scratchpad workspace windows in the overview

dragPreviewMode.label: Drag preview mode
dragPreviewMode.description: Controls retile/split guidance while dragging a window

retilePreviewOpacity.label: Retile preview opacity
retilePreviewOpacity.description: Opacity multiplier for split/swap guidance overlays

advanced.label: Advanced drag behavior
advanced.description: Fine tune drag thresholds and retiling behavior

dragSnapThreshold.label: Split target size
dragSnapThreshold.description: How much of a target window is dedicated to split previews before the center swaps

position.label: Position
position.description: Where the overview appears on screen

barMargin.label: Bar Margin
barMargin.description: Additional margin between overview and bar (when positioned at same edge)

backgroundOpacity.label: Background opacity
backgroundOpacity.description: Adjust the transparency of the overview backdrop

slideAnimation.label: Slide animation
slideAnimation.description: Animate overview sliding in from the bar (disable for instant popup)

workspaceLabels.label: Workspace labels
workspaceLabels.description: Show readable labels in each workspace thumbnail

workspaceLabelMode.label: Workspace label format
workspaceLabelMode.description: Choose whether labels use workspace number, name, or both
workspaceLabelMode.name: Name

specialWorkspaceStyle.label: Special workspace style
specialWorkspaceStyle.description: How scratchpad workspace labels are rendered

advanced.label: Advanced layout controls
advanced.description: Optional layout badges and workspace grid guides

showLayoutBadge.label: Layout badge
showLayoutBadge.description: Show the current Hyprland layout badge on each workspace

showRowColumnGuides.label: Row and column guides
showRowColumnGuides.description: Draw subtle center guides in workspace thumbnails

sectionDescriptions.visualMode: Choose live previews or the stylized pixel shader pipeline.
sectionDescriptions.windowIcons: Configure if and where application icons appear in previews.
sectionDescriptions.titleStrip: Tune title strip visibility, placement, and sizing.
sectionDescriptions.windowBadges: Control urgency, floating, fullscreen, and monitor indicator badges.
sectionDescriptions.dimmingFocus: Adjust inactive workspace dimming and hover emphasis.
sectionDescriptions.bordersCorners: Customize border gradients, widths, and preview corner behavior.

previewWorkspace.label: Preview workspace
previewWorkspace.no-windows: Open windows in this workspace to preview styles

visualMode.label: Preview mode
visualMode.description: Choose between live screencopy, the pixel shader look, or preview placeholders

shaderPreset.label: Shader preset
shaderPreset.description: Style used by the pixel shader preview

shaderPresetStrength.label: Dither strength
shaderPresetStrength.description: How strongly the selected shader preset stylizes the preview

pixelDensity.label: Pixel density
pixelDensity.description: Higher values keep more live preview detail

accentColor.label: Accent color
accentColor.description: Color used for selection indicator and special workspaces

windowIcons.label: Window icons
windowIcons.description: Show app icons inside each window preview card

colorizeWindowIcons.label: Colorize icons
colorizeWindowIcons.description: Tint non-Steam window icons with the accent color

windowIconPlacement.label: Icon placement
windowIconPlacement.description: Where app icons appear inside window previews

titleStripPosition.label: Title strip position
titleStripPosition.description: Where the title overlay is rendered

titleStripMode.label: Title strip mode
titleStripMode.description: Control when the bottom title strip is displayed

titleStripHeight.label: Title strip height
titleStripHeight.description: Height of the window title strip before monitor scaling

titleStripMeta.label: Title metadata
titleStripMeta.description: Secondary text shown in the title strip

urgencyBadge.label: Urgency badge
urgencyBadge.description: Show a red badge when a window requests urgent attention

floatingBadge.label: Floating badge
floatingBadge.description: Show a badge on windows currently floating in Hyprland

fullscreenBadge.label: Fullscreen badge
fullscreenBadge.description: Show a badge for fullscreen and maximized windows

dimInactive.label: Inactive workspace dim
dimInactive.description: How much previews are dimmed when not on the active workspace

inactiveSaturation.label: Inactive saturation
inactiveSaturation.description: How much color remains on inactive workspace previews

hoverLift.label: Hover emphasis
hoverLift.description: How strong the hovered window preview is emphasized

cornerMode.label: Corner mode
cornerMode.description: Use Hyprland rounding or force a fixed radius for previews

fixedCornerRadius.label: Fixed corner radius
fixedCornerRadius.description: Corner radius applied when corner mode is set to Fixed

useBorderGradient.label: Border gradient
useBorderGradient.description: Use accent gradients for focused preview borders

containerBorderWidth.label: Container border width
containerBorderWidth.description: Override the overview container border width

selectionBorderWidth.label: Selection border width
selectionBorderWidth.description: Override the active workspace indicator width

showMonitorIndicators.label: Show monitor indicators
showMonitorIndicators.description: Show monitor badges on workspace cells for workspaces bound to other monitors

enableCrossMonitorDrag.label: Cross-monitor drag
enableCrossMonitorDrag.description: Enable dragging windows to workspaces on other monitors, migrating the window to that monitor
